description: Allows one certificate authority to issue certificates for the domain: a CAA issue record and a CAA issuewild record at the root, each its own group. Both are essential OnApply, since the owner may tighten the policy later. Used by DoDomain (domain-connect-as-a-service) on behalf of its integrator applications; sharedProviderName is set so the consent screen can name the integrator beside DoDomain.
variableDescription: caDomain = the certificate authority's issuer domain, e.g. letsencrypt.org (groups issue and issuewild). Variables: caDomain.
